attchmntText: Markolines Pavement Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 12, 2026, titled "Markolines Pavement Technologies Limited Reports Financial Performance for Q2 & H1 FY27".
Markolines Pavement Technologies Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Markolines Pavement Technologies Limited held a Board Meeting on November 12, 2026. The Board approved the Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. Statutory auditors Jay Gupta & Associates issued Limited Review Reports on the financial statements. The reports stated that nothing came to their attention to suggest material misstatements in the results prepared under Indian Accounting Standards. The consolidated results include financial information for associate Uniqueuhpc Markolines LLP and joint venture Markolines Evrascon JV. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, Uniqueuhpc Markolines LLP reported revenue of Rs. 1976.68 lakhs and a profit after tax of Rs. 116.01 lakhs. Markolines Evrascon JV reported revenue of Rs. 2194.67 lakhs and a profit after tax of Rs. 79.54 lakhs. The company has filed these results with BSE and NSE pursuant to SEBI Listing Regulations.

attchmntText: Markolines Pavement Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 05, 2026, titled "Please find attached the Press Release issued by Markolines Pavement Technologies Limited regarding the receipt of work orders from Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) for road resurfacing works using microsurfacing technology on the Eastern Express Highway and Western Express Highway, aggregating to approximately ₹135.20 Crores.".

Markolines Pavement Technologies Limited ( the Company ) is pleased to inform that it has received two Letters of Acceptance-cum-Work Orders from Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) for undertaking microsurfacing works on the Eastern Express Highway and Western Express Highway, Mumbai, aggregating to ₹135.20 Crores.The detailed disclosure pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 is enclosed herewith.
